documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial performance for H2 and FY26, with revenue reaching approximately 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores. The company highlighted favorable global recycling industry dynamics due to primary supply disruptions in the Middle East and announced plans to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27, bringing total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually. Additionally, Baheti Recycling is expanding into higher-margin aluminum wire rods with a two-phase project in Dahegam, targeting significant revenue potential. Management also discussed ongoing working capital management and direct OEM engagement initiatives. Management stated that FY26 was a strong year, with revenue surpassing guidance by 12% and PAT growth exceeding guidance by over 15%.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins between 7% to 10% in the industry.
guidance.quote: So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue from Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant to be around 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will increase production and add another 250 crores in revenue.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects total revenue from the wire rod plant to be approximately 500 crores.
guidance.quote: So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management is more than hopeful of reaching a 4-digit revenue figure in the financial year.
guidance.quote: I'm more than hopeful that we'll reach somewhere around 4-digit in this financial alone.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue potential from the Aluminium Wire Rod division to reach ₹500 Crores a year when scaled to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years.
guidance.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

guidance.claim: The company is confidently positioned to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, pushing customers towards secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment, government policy tailwinds, and global industry dynamics favor secondary recycling aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that domestic scrap is currently much more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir, as on date, domestic scrap is much expensive than imported scrap, number one.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for aluminum wire rod is described as huge in an upbringing industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Aluminum wire rod, if I talk about aluminum wire rod, aluminum wire rod is a good industry. It is an upbringing industry and the demand is huge in aluminum wire.

demand_outlook.claim: The confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminium supply has been tightened by disruptions in the Middle East, with real pressure on availability.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar plant is on track to be commissioned by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: that will be combined with our solar plant, which is on track, and which will be commenced by the end of May 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod project is expected to commission by the end of October or early November.
capex_expansion.quote: By the end of October, you can say early November.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will require a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity, expected to generate ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to be up and running by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 scaling to 25,000 MT in forthcoming years brings the revenue potential to ₹500 Crores annually.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT with five more furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The aluminum wire rod product segment is noted as a higher margin product segment.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond our core alloy and deoxidant line, we are now entering into aluminum wire rod product, which is a higher margin product segment.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin from the wire rod business is expected to improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Increased production costs have been successfully passed on to selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: But ultimately, it has been diverted or it has been passed to our selling price, as simple as that.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces, with margin benefits starting from Q2 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.
